explanation: A people descended from the twelve sons of Israel who constitute God's chosen people in the Old Testament.
One of the twelve sons of Israel and the ancestor of the tribe of Benjamin, one of the twelve tribes of Israel.
A city in the territory of the tribe of Benjamin where a terrible event occurred that led to civil war between Benjamin and the other tribes of Israel.
A member of the tribe of Levi, appointed to carry out religious and ceremonial duties in Israel.
Groups of fighters or soldiers who fight together in a conflict.
Another name for God, often used to show respect and reverence.
An armed conflict between groups within the same nation or society.
A sacred chest that contained the stone tablets with the Ten Commandments and symbolized God's presence among the Israelites.
An action or process in which one turns from sin and seeks forgiveness from God.
To win or overcome an enemy in a conflict or battle.
